nodes.description: Mice lacking Dnah10 or carrying a patient-derived missense variant reproduce male infertility with MMAF. A later study of knockout and knock-in mice reported primary ciliary dyskinesia features as well.

In DNAH10-deficient spermatids the manchette functions abnormally and axonemal proteins are mislocalized. DNAH10 enhances binding between the deubiquitinase UCHL3 and PACRG, which UCHL3 stabilizes. The study is indexed with Mice and Humans in MeSH; the abstract does not say which observations come from which species, and this route has not been shown in patient tissue.

evidence.reference_title: DNAH10 interacts with UCHL3-PACRG complex to coordinate sperm head and flagella development during spermiogenesis.
evidence.snippet: Additionally, DNAH10 dysfunction leads to impaired manchette function and aberrant localisation of axonemal proteins.

evidence.reference_title: DNAH10 interacts with UCHL3-PACRG complex to coordinate sperm head and flagella development during spermiogenesis.
evidence.snippet: In this process, DNAH10 exerts a bridging effect, enhancing the interaction between the UCHL3-PACRG complex to facilitate their involvement in manchette function.
